lesson: Friday's one bet landed: Frosinone beat Sassuolo 4-2 at about 2.45 for +$7.70, as Sassuolo's poor away record suggested. We passed on the other six games (Deportivo 1-1 Levante was one of them) because the prices were fair or too short.

matches.analysis: Prices: Heerenveen 1.65 / Draw 4.20 / Excelsior 4.50. Over 2.5 1.44 / Under 2.5 2.70; BTTS Yes 1.50 / No 2.50. Heerenveen are L W D L D and Excelsior L D L D W, so there is little between them on form. A 1.65 favourite with that record leaves no margin, and the goals prices are too short. No bet.

Prices: Frankfurt 1.91 / Draw 3.90 / Koln 3.30. Over 2.5 1.36 / Under 2.5 3.20; BTTS Yes 1.36 / No 3.00. Frankfurt are L W D W L and were beaten 6-0 at Leipzig last Saturday. Koln are W D L D L and won 2-1 against Gladbach last time out. We could not confirm a reliable team-news picture for either side, and the match odds are fair. The goals prices at 1.36 are too short. No bet.

Prices: Widzew 2.20 / Draw 3.40 / Wisla 2.90. Over 2.5 1.67 / Under 2.5 2.15; BTTS Yes 1.57 / No 2.25. Wisla (L W W W D) are in much better form than Widzew (L D D D L), but the 2.90 already reflects that and we found no team news to add. Wisla or draw at 1.67 is close to fair. No bet.

Prices: Frosinone 2.45 / Draw 3.40 / Sassuolo 2.60. Over 2.5 1.44 / Under 2.5 2.75; BTTS Yes 1.40 / No 2.75. Frosinone are ninth, have won four of their last six home games and average 2.0 points a game at home, scoring 2.0 a game there. Sassuolo have not won away (0.25 points a game in their last four away games), have conceded 2.25 a game on the road and have let in a goal in each of their last nine league games. Several Sassuolo players are injured or doubtful, including Kone, Boloca, Pieragnolo and Leysen. Frosinone have Grillitsch and Birligea doubtful. Sassuolo drew 1-1 with Milan and won 4 of their last 10, so this is not a big edge. The two sides are priced as near equals, and Sassuolo's away record says they should not be. Take 2.40 or better. Draw No Bet is a safer alternative at about 1.83. The stake is 1%.

Prices: Le Mans 2.90 / Draw 3.30 / Toulouse 2.25. Over 2.5 1.73 / Under 2.5 2.10; BTTS Yes 1.60 / No 2.30. Le Mans lost 3-1 at PSG last Saturday and are L L W D D. Toulouse drew 2-2 at Monaco and are D L W D L. Neither side has an edge on form and the prices are fair. No bet.

Prices: Deportivo 2.10 / Draw 3.40 / Levante 3.40. Over 2.5 1.91 / Under 2.5 1.91; BTTS Yes 1.70 / No 2.05. Deportivo have not won in five (L L D L D) and are without Aubameyang, Eddahchouri and Casado, with Amatucci suspended. Levante are missing Eyong, Sotelo and keeper Primo. The injuries cancel out and the prices are even. No bet.

Prices: Burnley 3.00 / Draw 3.30 / Wolves 2.20. Over 2.5 1.80 / Under 2.5 2.00; BTTS Yes 1.65 / No 2.15. Burnley have 15 players listed as out (Humphreys, Beyer, Barnes, Banel, Cullen, Mejbri and others) and drew 2-2 with Charlton on Tuesday. Wolves have six out and lost 3-1 at home to Bolton. The market already makes Burnley the underdog at home, so the price is fair and the last meeting was a 1-1 draw. No bet.
